更新多了一条路。

- 检查更新时先问 [jokbet.jokerben.top](https://jokbet.jokerben.top)，没有回应再问 GitHub
- 下载更新时，一边失败就自动换另一边重试；两边的安装包完全相同，都用同一个签名校验
- 连不上或下载中途卡住会及时放弃，换另一条路，不会一直等下去

从 0.1.0 升到这一版仍然走 GitHub；从这一版往后，每次更新都有两条路。

---

Updates now have a second route.

- Checking for updates asks [jokbet.jokerben.top](https://jokbet.jokerben.top) first, and GitHub if it does not answer
- A download that fails on one is retried on the other; both serve the same files, checked against the same signature
- A connection that cannot be made, or a download that stalls, is given up on and the other route tried, instead of waiting forever

Updating from 0.1.0 to this version still goes through GitHub; from this version on, every update has both routes.
